headings.usage: Use for all UI text, labels, headers, and tabs.

data.usage: MANDATORY for all numerical data, tabular data, axis labels, timeframes, and strike prices to ensure vertical alignment.

layout.general: High-density data layout. Minimalist, strict grid, avoiding rounded aesthetics where possible. Optimize for scanability.
layout.sidebar: Fixed width (e.g., w-72 or w-80). Contains index switcher, expiries checklist, strike range slider, and quick filters.
layout.main_content: Fluid width, dense grid. Use Tailwind CSS grid-cols-12 for complex layouts. Header occupies full width of main content.
layout.spacing: Tight padding (p-3 to p-4 for cards). Gap-4 for grids.
layout.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-md (6px) maximum. Avoid fully rounded pill shapes except for status indicators.

components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs. Customize to look like underlined segments rather than pill buttons for a professional feel.
components.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary buttons use bg-slate-900 text-white. Secondary buttons use bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700.
components.timeframe_pills: Small, dense toggles. text-xs JetBrains Mono. Selected state: bg-slate-900 text-white. Unselected: bg-slate-100 text-slate-600.
components.alerts: Use Sonner for toast notifications. High contrast. Red background with white text for OI reversal spikes. Must include sound integration.

chart.configuration: X-axis: Strike Price. Y-axis: OI Volume. Legend at top right.
chart.visuals: Current Call OI: Solid Red (#DC2626). Previous Call OI: Transparent fill, Red Stroke. Current Put OI: Solid Green (#16A34A). Previous Put OI: Transparent fill, Green Stroke.

icons.usage: Use 16px or smaller icons. Keep stroke width consistent at 1.5. Use sparingly, prioritize text labels.

image_urls.description: Minimalist geometric abstract design to be used as a small brand mark in the sidebar header.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA. JetBrains Mono data must be high contrast against white.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add descriptive data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='tab-oi-change', data-testid='btn-refresh').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout using a strict left sidebar and right main content area.
Sidebar must include NIFTY/SENSEX toggle, Intraday/Custom range, Expiries checklist, and 'Strikes above and below ATM' buttons.
The header must display Index name, current price, % change, ATM strike, PCR, and INDIAVIX densely.
Main chart must be implemented using Recharts, properly mapping the solid vs outlined bars to distinguish current vs previous OI data.
Implement the OI Auto-refresh logic (every 15s) and display the 'Last Refreshed' timestamp clearly at the bottom.
Alert logic should trigger a highly visible toast and sound when an 'OI reversal spike' occurs.
Setup an API credentials modal for Zerodha KiteConnect (API Key + Access Token) accessible via sidebar or header.
